ui.title: Order-to-Cash Revenue Leakage Monitor
ui.tagline: Finds revenue that leaks between order and cash: matches every delivery to its order and invoice in code (not by guesswork), flags unbilled deliveries, under-billing and unexplained credits, explains the root causes, and opens recovery tasks once finance agrees.
